source_metadata.exact_title: Pharmacokinetics of intraperitoneal cefalothin and cefazolin in patients being treated for peritoneal dialysis-associated peritonitis

duplicate_review.finding: No duplicate atoms identified by deterministic statement+page review.

extraction_limitations: The source is a small single-center observational PK study; atoms preserve source-reported PK findings and do not convert them into clinical outcome evidence.
No adverse-event endpoint was reported in the retrieved primary article; no adverse-event atom was created.
Some figure-derived patterns were anchored to surrounding result text rather than digitizing plotted median values.
The supplement was used only for assay detail, future-research statements, and explicit limitations; its reference list was not atomized.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated field for study design, site, registry identifier, or narrative p-value comparator; these are preserved in canonical statements/tags where needed.
QuantitativeResult requires a scalar estimate even for multi-arm median comparisons; the estimate stores the cefalothin arm median while both arm values are retained in arms[].
